request.gqlQuery:
query CheckItemAvailability($request: ItemCheckAvailabilityRequestDto!) {
  checkItemAvailability(request: $request) {
    id
    type
    storeId
    isAvailable
    unavailabilityReason
    message
    storeStatus {
      isOpen
      isOverloaded
      operationStatus
      reason
    }
    variants {
      variantId
      variantName
      isSell
      onHand
      isAvailable
      reason
    }
    comboGroups {
      groupId
      groupTitle
      isRequired
      minSelection
      maxSelection
      isGroupSatisfied
      items {
        productId
        productName
        variantId
        variantName
        isSell
        onHand
        isAvailable
        reason
      }
    }
  }
}
